cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import max96
from protocol import loads, validate
cases = [max96.build(i, mode=('route' if i%2==0 else 'admit'), cap=1, demand=1000, events=8) for i in range(6)]

req = validate(loads(t))

open('/tmp/max96hard.json','w').write(t)
